resources.string: Microsoft Word, built for your Galaxy Z Fold 8
Opens Word in Chrome. Saves to OneDrive automatically.

Word shows its full editor (File, Home, Insert, Layout, References, Review) when Chrome asks for the desktop site. Set it once:

1. Tap Open Word in Chrome below.
2. In Chrome, tap ⋮ (top right).
3. Tick Desktop site. Chrome remembers this for Word.
Add one-tap Word to home screen
Check your home screen for the Word icon.
Your home screen doesn\'t allow this. Long-press the Fold Word icon and drag "Word" to the home screen instead.
Opens Word inside this app. Microsoft blocks document editing here, so use Open Word to edit.
Sign-in, subscriptions and saving happen on Microsoft\'s own pages. Fold Word never sees or stores your Microsoft password.
Couldn\'t load Word. Check your connection, then tap Reload. You can also use Edit in Chrome.
This download can only be saved in the browser. Use Edit in Chrome.
